description: This Java source file defines the ConnectivityModelFactory class, which provides factory methods for creating and manipulating connectivity-related objects such as Connections, Metrics, Sources, Targets, and related configurations within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, builder pattern instantiation, and object copying, focusing on connectivity modeling.

classes.name: ConnectivityModelFactory
